title: Are there any requirements for stakeholders to transact under the SCT? - Uganda Revenue Authority

# Are there any requirements for stakeholders to transact under  the SCT?
Yes, Key stakeholders must fulfill some requirements to be able to smoothly transact under the SCT clearance procedures.
## Importers & Exporters
Appoint a licensed clearing agent/or get licensed for own
Develop a working relationship with shipping line

## Customs Clearing Agents

Acquire knowledge in SCT & training in other Revenue Authorities Customs

## Transporters
Acquire Transit License from the respective Revenue Authorities
